default.name: Leila Haddad
default.bio: Led research teams at two Toronto software companies for eight years. Spent too many evenings scrubbing through recordings to find a single quote for a roadmap review.
default.quote: The best insight in the room is usually buried at minute 43 of a call nobody re-watched.

default.name: Mateo Ruiz
default.bio: Built speech recognition for call centers in Buenos Aires and Montréal. Wrote the first Fieldnote transcriber on a weekend and has been rewriting it ever since.
default.quote: If a transcript arrives after the meeting notes, nobody reads it. Speed is the feature.
